Definition: the back; by analogy, the middle
BiblicalUsage: gêv is the word for the back, back, midst. I meet it 7 times across the Bible, and Job is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gêv matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
